newsitem.title: USA: Multi-Market stake raised by Loeb group.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Market stake raised by Loeb group.

text.p: A group including Loeb Partners Corp said Tuesday it raised its stake in Multi-Market Radio Inc to the equivalent of 244,350 class A common shares or 7.49 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 48,800 additional shares between September 6 and November 5 for $11.23 to $12.27 a share.
The group said its stake also includes 45,500 warrants to buy additional shares, which, if exercised, would raise its stake to 289,851 shares or 8.89 percent of the class A shares outstanding.
